kv.allPlanned: Every one was on a plan

kv.notPlanned_other: {count} were on no plan: counted apart

adherence.caption: The line is the share finished on or before the day of their last bar on the plan; the bars count the work orders finished that week. A week with nothing measured has no point.
adherence.weeksLabel: The weeks: each opens the work orders behind it
adherence.weekOpen: Open the work orders finished in {week}
adherence.tableLabel: Schedule adherence per line and week
adherence.definition: Planned: the first bar's start and the last bar's end of the work order on the version the floor had when its work started (else the first version with it, else the working plan). Actual: its first recorded work and its completion. Days are the site's days; a later replan never moves the goalposts.
adherence.incomplete: More than 5,000 work orders finished in this period: the first 5,000 are counted.
adherence.printTotals: {late} late, {notPlanned} on no plan; finished {days} days from plan on average.

utilisation.hint_one: What happened from {from} to {to}, and the plan's load for this week ({count} week ahead).
utilisation.hint_other: What happened from {from} to {to}, and the plan's load for {count} weeks from this one.
utilisation.hintPast: What happened from {from} to {to}; no load ahead.
utilisation.axes: Weeks across; utilisation on the left, the plan's load on the right.
utilisation.emptyHint: Nothing was earned on the lines and work centres in the period and nothing is booked ahead.
utilisation.caption: The line is what happened (earned standard minutes over the minutes its people were there); the bars are the plan's load (booked over capacity, as Capacity & load counts it).
utilisation.weeksLabel: The weeks of {lane}: each opens the work orders behind it
utilisation.workshopHeld: A workshop's weeks open on Capacity & load.
utilisation.tableLabel: Utilisation and load per lane and week
utilisation.definition: Utilisation: the standard minutes of the good whole garments reported on the lane's stations that week (never per person or station), over its people × its working time. Load: the open work orders' minutes still to do, placed by the board, over the lane's capacity at its planned efficiency.
utilisation.workshopPast: A workshop's past weeks say nothing: its jobs are what is left from today.

cover.hint: What the site's plan needs from {from} to {to}, the soonest to run out first.
cover.hintWeeks_one: What the site's plan needs in the next {count} week.

cover.empty: No material has demand in this horizon
cover.emptyHint: No order of this site needs material in these weeks, and no material is below its safety stock.
cover.counts: {shortNow} short now · {stockOut} running out in the horizon · {belowSafety} below safety stock · {covered} covered
cover.more_one: {count} more material is counted above but not listed.
cover.more_other: {count} more materials are counted above but not listed.
cover.exportHeld: Select the materials to export first.
cover.definition: Projected stock: the usable stock on hand plus the open purchase lines (and a firm planned order) on their due day, less what the orders still need on the day each needs it, nothing more ordered — the item profile's numbers (What to buy & make › Projected stock). The stock-out date is the first day it falls below zero; days of cover count the days until then.
